summary: Goldman Sachs Private Credit Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the amended BNPP Revolving Credit Facility for its SPV. The amendment increases the facility from $1.1B to $1.5B, extends the borrowing period to April 2028 and maturity to April 2029, and reduces the margin from 1.615% to 1.462% per annum during the reinvestment period. No special-situation transformation occurs—this is a routine debt refinancing/upsizing. The registrant acts as equityholder and investment advisor. No event triggers risk-arb activity or corporate structure change.
